description.name: Spaceship
description.tagline: Free, production-hardened registrar module for the Spaceship.com Public API.
description.long: Full domain lifecycle automation for Spaceship.com: registration, renewals, transfers, nameservers, WHOIS contacts, registrar lock, EPP codes, DNS records, ID protection and built-in TLD pricing sync. Async-safe operations, hardened logging, rate-limit-aware caching. No paid add-ons, no licence checks, no third-party code. Maintained by BIGBANG ITS (its.ae).
